verdict: A near-faithful Wikipedia Main Page whose every block, icon and string is right, let down by section headings 3 px too tall that push both columns' content 2-5 px down; well built with auto-layout and four components, but has no shared styles and uses fixed-width text blocks.

top_defects.where: section headings (From today's featured article, Help us improve, In the news, Did you know)
top_defects.what: heading boxes are 39 px tall instead of 36 px, plus slightly larger gaps, so content drifts down: body text ~2 px lower under the first headings, 'In the news' and 'Did you know ...' headings ~3-4 CSS px lower, news items ~4 px lower (grid cells mid-page meanDiff 19-46)
Arimo instead of the reference's system sans (Helvetica/Arial rendering); metrics match but strokes are slightly lighter and glyph widths differ by a pixel here and there

top_defects.where: "Welcome to Wikipedia," title and section headings
top_defects.what: title and heading text drawn in #202122 grey instead of #101418 near-black

top_defects.where: Help us improve intro, In the news items
top_defects.what: the text wrapping around the photos uses fixed-width blocks (Intro 415 px, News items 467 px) and the photo figures are positioned absolutely, so editing the text or the image does not reflow the column

leftover 67x2 'Indicator' rectangles inside the Talk/View source/View history tabs (wider than 25-77 px tabs); a 'Checked' ellipse in every radio; text layers 500 px wide inside a 498 px content frame and 590 px inside 588 px (overflow)
no shared color or text styles (styled: 0): #3366cc, #202122 and the box tints are repeated as raw values
each long paragraph is a single text layer with inline link styling and no paragraph structure; 53 absolute layers next to 67 auto-layouts

strengths: All content is present and exact, including counts, links, captions, the onboarding dot and the cut-off Did you know item
Logo, tagline and toolbar icons are real vectors from the provided SVGs, with correct sizes; the three photos are correctly cropped
Tab, Box heading, List item and Radio option are components with 20 instances; frames are named after the UI (Header, Page tabs, Welcome banner, Appearance panel)
